checkedAlternates.risk: Ablative expresses motion away from a place.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Ablative is paired with Genitive as origin/source ("of/from", group-2), whereas Dative, Locative, Instrumental, and Allative express recipient, location, means, or motion toward (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Ergative is less familiar than Latin cases.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Ergative marks the agent of a transitive verb, making it a core clause argument case alongside Nominative and Accusative (group-3).
